observations: No indexed Candidate matches the critical dispatch-context projection or callback-ordering guard.
The unit can proceed under the active typed effect and Context Kernel contracts with a fail-closed rollback.
fragment.purpose: Select the protected active baseline for dispatch-time critical-source revocation binding.
unresolved: whether stable authority identity and heartbeat liveness can be separated without weakening revocation

local_learn.observation: A dispatch security boundary should not trial unrelated Execute prompt overlays; the existing deterministic contracts and explicit rollback are the correct baseline.

result.baseline: Use the merged semantic-component DecisionContextManifest implementation, typed effect plan/authorization/dispatch/reconciliation/adjudication stack, immutable invocation journal, and generation-6 single-writer lease as protected active baselines.

costs.external: No production provider side effect is required; callbacks remain test doubles and repository publication is separately idempotent.
costs.failure_risk: High if verification occurs after claim creation or compares volatile whole-file identity; temporal ordering and projection semantics must be tested directly.
costs.latency: Bounded implementation, focused failure-order tests, protected regressions, and exact-head CI.
costs.quality: Closes a concrete temporal context-control gap but does not itself demonstrate useful behavior.
costs.token: Only selected stable authority and policy fields plus digests are retained.
costs.tool: Local repository tools and isolated GitHub publication only.

evidence_to_collect: a bounded manifest-derived critical projection stored with effect plan and authorization identity
immediate pre-claim and pre-callback verification of live lease/fence/status, user inbox revision, effective policy, and action constraints
same-authority heartbeat refresh succeeds while stale heartbeat and authority or policy revocation fail closed
failed verification creates neither dispatch claim nor provider call
completed exact replay remains side-effect-free after later control-state changes

result.reason: No indexed Execute Candidate governs the authorization-to-dispatch critical-source recheck or typed Work effect identity. The available candidates concern capability benchmarks, campaign authoring or providers, live-campaign execution, request rendezvous, or generic self-application hygiene; applying one would introduce an unrelated variable at a security boundary.
regression_checks: historical effect records and frozen Work requests remain unchanged
raw fence tokens and secrets do not enter the projection
authorization, idempotency, dispatch, receipt, reconciliation, and adjudication digests remain cross-bound
completed replay never calls the provider
single-writer lease and current executor binding remain unchanged
internal dispatch safety is not reported as behavioral improvement, AGI, or completion
result.rollback: Retain the current fail-closed typed effect stack and merged semantic manifests, leave the new branch unmerged, and preserve failing temporal evidence if the projection cannot distinguish safe liveness renewal from revocation or changes completed replay.
